about: B1f: CX2's sim-test (run 44303693502, before 0257) had three turn errors (path agent_error, the technical line), each on the turn after the customer corrected a line. The run's artifact (sim-results, results.jsonl) gives each turn's text; the planner's input is the customer's line as the reading gives it and the whole message (`_message`). On the database without 0257 the planner stops on 'cannot extract elements from a scalar' (0256's catalog_other_kind reading JSON null candidates); with 0257 it plans. sim-006's own fault was elsewhere: «مياه فوارة طلاية» was not a word of Talaya (the sim's world has no Arabic name for it), so it was offered oranges, then told we do not carry it; 0253 adds the words (evals/cases/b1f_labneh_search.json, talaya). Run by test/db/b1f-sim-turn-errors.test.ts.
